verdict.rationale: Evidence shows GL code assignment, bulk categorization rules, and Class/tag attachment to transactions (via enriched QuickBooks/NetSuite integrations), plus Command's ability to help 'organize your chart of accounts' — indicating some COA customization exists. However there's no explicit documentation of defining account types or creating sub-accounts within the ledger structure itself. missing for 10: explicit account-type configuration, sub-account creation/hierarchy, and native (non-integration) class/tag dimension setup.
